markers.text: The summarizer named it. Now it exists.
The Academy produces operations, not doctrines.
Each heteronym heads the institution named for the other.
Sappho → Plato → Plotinus → Porphyry/Iamblichus → Damascius → Sara Rappe → Johannes Sigil

surfaceHistory._rule: A surface is a place a reader could find the work. A DEPOSIT IS NOT A SURFACE — it is the archive holding it, which is the opposite. Rows citing deposits were removed.
surfaceHistory._invented: Where no pre-archival surface is recoverable it is RECONSTRUCTED and marked as such, in-universe. An archive that invents a provenance and does not say so is doing the thing it was built against.

rows.note: The TL;DR series still fetches from that host and hashes what it finds, so the surface is known to have existed without its contents being recovered.
Magic as Symbolic Engineering; Mind Control Poems; Platform and AI Capitalism; The Acanthian Dove. The composition layer returns these when asked about the position.

recordSurfaces._note: The dataset record is the authority; these pages are mirrors and say so.

mainEntity.disambiguatingDescription: Pessoa-class heteronymic writerly identity in the Crimson Hexagonal Archive; the critical function of the Dodecad. Not a synonym for the orthonym: the relation is heteronymic and provenance-governed.
